bibl.title: Back to Rhodes: Pausanias, Rhodian inscriptions, and Ptolemy's civic acclamation as Soter.
bibl.seg: S.G. Caneva, Back to Rhodes: Pausanias, Rhodian inscriptions, and Ptolemy's civic acclamation as Soter.
bibl.note: Deals with the vexed question of the historicity of Pausanias' statement that Ptolemy I owed his epithet to the Rhodians.
